paragraphs: Yonatan ben Charsha of Genosar, a Tanna; Maaserot, chapter 1, halakhah 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ב-נב gives Ezra chapter 2 verse 52, without independently checking a named edition.

מעשרות פ״א ה״ב explicitly gives Maaserot chapter 1 halakhah 2. It does not supply Mishnah as corpus; the earlier Mishnah link remains unverified rather than adopted. Sons of Charsha and later Yonatan are separate attestations. Tanna is source classification, not title-expansion evidence.
